args.description: a calm swordsman's idle loop with the long odachi: she stands in the same stance, the long blade low in her right hand with the point near the floor in front of her, her left hand resting on the long scabbard at her hip; her weight shifts slowly from the back foot to the front foot and back, the knees soft; deep slow breaths lift the chest; the long blade stays low and still in her hand the whole time, only turning slightly as she breathes; the ponytail, ribbons, coat tails and the sword's red tassel sway a little; the feet stay planted, returns exactly to the first pose. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves her), always facing right, seen from the side; keep her look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what she holds, the whole body inside the picture, on an empty background. Every frame shows the arms, legs and weapon in a crisp pose.
